facts.fact: The Registration and Identification of Persons Act (Cap. 36, originally Act No. 11 of 1986), an Act of Parliament providing for registration of persons and issue of identity cards, is recorded as still in force in the Cap. 36 R.E. 2023 edition, per the Attorney-General's e-Library catalogue record dated 2025-07-01.
